title: The package-manager guard follows cd
notes: Retro 2026-11-24: new-crm has package-lock.json at its root and pnpm-lock.yaml in backoffice/ and storefront/. 'cd storefront && pnpm install' was refused 4 times ('lockfile is package-lock.json: install with npm'), so #1279 went to CI unchecked. src/main/workflow/package-manager-guard.ts judges the session's folder; follow the command's cd the way test-run-guard.ts does since 92f7e4ad, with a test for 'cd storefront && pnpm install'.

comments.body: Pull request #349 opened: Follow a cd in the package-manager guard https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/349

PR #349 review loop: floor-addressed after 2 rounds, 4 findings addressed, 0 rejected. Commits c63faab1, 828c455a kept. 5ed72c31 (share the cd/subshell walk between partsWithFolders and removesOwnWorktree, which also fixes cd -P in worktree-guard) was rejected by the final check over a 152-wide comment line and reverted in c5460bb8, so that [low] thread at hook-answer.ts:103 is still open. NOT ready to merge: CI fails on windows. In package-manager-guard.test.ts, 'judges an install in the folder a cd earlier in the line moved to' gets 'expected undefined to be defined'. Probable cause: resolveWord uses path.resolve, which returns D:\work\crm\storefront on Windows, so the POSIX fixture paths never match. The other 4 checks pass. No conflict with main.
